definitions.explanation: A box for receiving or sending mail, either a personal mailbox at one's home or a public collection box for posting letters.

examples.japanese: {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: There was a letter in the mailbox.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go check the mailbox every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I installed a new mailbox beside the front entrance.

notes:
{郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ} can refer to either a private mailbox for receiving mail or a public red postbox for sending mail. In everyday speech, ⟦{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け→郵便受け：04889_yuubinuke⟧ is more common for a home receiving box, while ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧ is widely used for both types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ — to open the mailbox
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投函|とうかん}→投函：23418_toukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to drop into the mailbox
- {郵便箱|ゆうびんばこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいだ — the mailbox is full

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧ — mailbox; postbox (loanword, very common in daily conversation)
- ⟦{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け→郵便受け：04889_yuubinuke⟧ — mail slot; receiving mailbox (specifically for receiving)
- {私書箱|ししょばこ} — post office box (PO box, rented at a post office)
